current_unresolved_limits: Explicit Imperial output is ignored for all three economy inputs tested. Carry output volume unit separately through the typed request, arithmetic, rendering and accepted-output theorem.

The price parser treats suffix-qualified gallon (Imperial) as US gallons. Three observed costs are numerically wrong; prefix-qualified US/Imperial gallons are valid requests withheld. Replace the price boolean with a volume-unit type independent of economy units.
All 15 multisentence cost requests are withheld although equivalent single-question forms sometimes answer. Inspect the narrative guard without broadly weakening it.
Braking gradients, varying traction and emissions assumptions remain unaudited.
